description: This file contains test cases for the GCSBucketLogger class within the litellm project, focusing on its integration with Google Cloud Storage (GCS), including credential loading, object upload/download, and logging configuration. It also includes tests for different scenarios such as failure cases, folder-in-bucket naming, and handling of IAM-based authentication.

classes.name: GCSBucketLogger
classes.description: A logger class for integrating with Google Cloud Storage, supporting uploading logs, downloading objects, and configuration management.

classes.name: StandardLoggingPayload
classes.description: A data class representing the structured payload for logging, containing details about the model, response, metadata, and status.

classes.name: StandardCallbackDynamicParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating dynamic parameters for callback configurations, such as GCS bucket name and service account path.

methods.name: load_vertex_ai_credentials()
methods.description: Loads credentials for Vertex AI by reading environment variables and updating a temporary JSON credential file.

methods.name: test_aaabasic_gcs_logger()
methods.description: Async test for basic GCS logging functionality including upload, download, and delete, verifying log data correctness.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logger_failure()
methods.description: Async test for logging failures, ensuring the failure status and costs are correctly recorded.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logging_per_request_with_callback_set()
methods.description: Async test verifying GCS logging per request with explicit callback configuration and cleanup.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logging_per_request_with_no_litellm_callback_set()
methods.description: Async test verifying GCS logging when no callbacks are set, including failure scenario.

methods.name: test_aaaget_gcs_logging_config_without_service_account()
methods.description: Async test to verify GCS logging configuration works with IAM authentication (no service account).

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logger_with_folder_in_bucket_name()
methods.description: Async test for handling bucket name specified with a folder path, ensuring correct object handling.

methods.name: test_create_file_e2e()
methods.description: Synchronous test for create_file function ensuring it is called correctly with a file payload.

methods.name: test_create_file_e2e_jsonl()
methods.description: Synchronous test for create_file with a JSONL file, verifying file creation, and mocking the upload call.
